# Bali AI Consultant

> Bali AI Consultant is a Lumindra company, founded by Mark Tulloch, that builds practical AI systems for Bali businesses: AI training, WhatsApp automation, websites, hospitality workflows and custom AI-powered business operating systems for staff, rosters, SOPs, daily operations, reporting and dashboards. The model was built inside Sunshooters Bar & Grill, a live Bali venue. Prices are starting estimates in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR); final scope is confirmed after discovery. First step: a free call on WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Founder: Mark Tulloch
- Parent brand: Lumindra (https://lumindra.co/)
- Area served: Bali, Indonesia
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821 4402 9645 (English and Indonesian)
- Proven at: Sunshooters Bar & Grill, Bali

## Services and starting prices (IDR)
- AI Starter (four private 30-minute sessions for beginners): Rp 2,000,000 total
- The 18-Minute Hospitality AI System (the morning workflow used at Sunshooters): Rp 2,500,000 one-time setup and training
- Business WhatsApp Automation: custom setup from Rp 5,000,000. Official WhatsApp API and message fees are separate unless scoped
- Professional Website Builds: from Rp 5,000,000
- AI-Powered Business Operating Systems: setup from Rp 10,000,000
- Personal Song Creations (Conscious Systems): Rp 500,000
- Apocalypse turnaround intensive for founders: by application, limited places

## Operating system packages
- Foundation: from Rp 10,000,000, typical delivery 2 to 3 weeks. Single-location businesses replacing paper and spreadsheets
- Operations Pro: from Rp 20,000,000, typical delivery 3 to 5 weeks. Growing hospitality, villas, gyms, agencies and service businesses
- Connected Intelligence: from Rp 35,000,000, typical delivery 5 to 8 weeks. Multi-location or data-ready operations needing POS or data connections
